entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit support. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand tracker. I've had it for about a month and I want my money back. Now.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

A preference? I just want to return it! It was a total impulse buy and I just don't use it. It's been sitting on my dresser since I got it. I've completely changed my mind. Your policy says 90 days, so just process the return or get me your manager!
I understand your frustration, sir, and there's no need for a manager. I can definitely handle this for you. Let me just pull up the policy details for your account... one moment.

Okay, thank you for waiting. I see the details here. So, just so you know for the future, for a preference-based return like this, our updated process would normally involve our VeloFit resale marketplace. However, looking at your purchase date, I can see you are still well within the 90-day return window. So I can absolutely approve a full refund for you today.
Oh. Well, fine. That's what I expected in the first place. About time. What do I need to do?

I am emailing a pre-paid return label to you right now. Just place the VeloBand back in its original packaging, affix the label, and drop it off at the post office. Once our warehouse receives it, you'll see the refund on your original payment method in about 3 to 5 business days.
Perfect. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
